login.title: Log in
login.error: Couldn't log in with that email and password. Check both and try again.
privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.s1Body: The quiz never asks for your name, email or phone number. Your answers are used only to suggest a product in the moment; the answers themselves are not stored.
privacy.s2Body: To improve the site we keep anonymous counts: how many times the quiz was started and finished, which products were suggested, how often a product page was viewed and its order button pressed. None of it is tied to a person.
privacy.s3Body: Product images are hosted on a third-party image service. If you follow an order button or a social link, that service's own privacy policy (Facebook, Messenger and so on) applies.
quiz.noResult: No matching product found. Please try again.

product.buyNote: We arrange the order and payment with you directly.
dash.title: Dashboard
dash.descQuiz: Each quiz has its own questions, products and link. The main quiz opens at /quiz.
dash.descProducts: Add, edit and publish products. Click a row to edit it.
dash.descStats: How many people viewed each product, how many pressed Order, and how the quiz is performing.
account.title: Your account
account.emailChangeSent: Check your new email for a confirmation link. Nothing changes until you click it.
account.emailNote: Changing your email sends a confirmation link to the new address first.
stats.loadError: Couldn't load your stats. Refresh to try again.
brandEd.taglineBody: One sentence, used as the home page headline and in the footer. Each quiz has its own headline, set on the Quiz tab.
brandEd.aboutBody: Your company introduction: who you are, what makes your products different, delivery and payment terms. Shown in full on the About page, and its opening on the home page.
quizEd.linkBody: The link to put in social posts, ads and on packaging. Visits that come from the QR code are counted separately in Stats.
quizEd.noQuestions: No questions yet. Your quiz needs at least one to go live.
prodEd.buyNowHint: Where the Order button goes: your online store or Messenger (https://m.me/…). Leave it empty to hide the button.
prodEd.videoHint: Paste a YouTube, Vimeo, Facebook, TikTok, or Instagram link — the platform is detected automatically.
prodEd.boostHint: When several products match the same category, the higher score is shown first. It never adds a product that doesn't match.
common.loadError: Couldn't load. Refresh to try again.
notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: There is nothing at this address. The link may be out of date, or the product may have been taken off the site.
video.unsupported: This video link isn't supported yet. Please use YouTube, Vimeo, Facebook, TikTok, or Instagram.
dashCat.title: Categories
dashCat.body: Group products and connect quiz answers to them.
dashCat.empty: Without categories the quiz can't suggest any product.
dashCat.slugTaken: The same code appears twice. Each code must be unique.
footer.disclaimer: Nothing on this site replaces a doctor's advice. Supplements are not intended to treat, diagnose or prevent any disease; they may support general wellbeing. If you are pregnant, breastfeeding or taking medication, talk to your doctor first.
home.subtitleNoQuiz: Take a look at our products.
home.stepsBody: We use your answers to suggest the best match from our own products.
home.step1Body: A few short questions about your day to day: energy, sleep, immunity and so on.
home.step2Body: You get the one or two products that fit your answers best, with the reason each was picked.
home.step3Body: Read the details on the product page, then get in touch with us directly to order.
contact.empty: Contact details have not been added yet.
login.heading: Manager sign-in
login.managersOnly: This area is for the site's manager only. You don't need to sign in to take the quiz or browse products.
dash.descSite: Company name, logo, introduction and contact details. Shown on the home, About and Contact pages.
dash.addProductHint: A new product starts hidden. Fill in the rest on the next page, then publish it.
siteEd.name: Company name
siteEd.contactBody: Only the fields you fill in are shown on the site. Adding your Facebook page link also adds a “message us on Messenger” button.
dashCat.slugWarning: Changing a code or deleting a category disconnects the products and quiz answers that used it. They need to be set again.
prodEd.publishedBody: Visitors can see this product on the site and in the quiz.
prodEd.hiddenBody: Visitors can't see it and its link doesn't work. Switch it on and save when it's ready.
prodEd.claimsHint: Never write that a product “cures”, “treats” or “diagnoses” anything. Use wording like “may support”.
prodEd.noCategoryWarning: With no category selected, the quiz will never suggest this product.
prodEd.socialContactBody: Fill these in only if this product has its own contact channel. Company-wide details go under “Site content”.
prodEd.deleteBody: A deleted product's page and any printed QR code stop working. To hide it for a while instead, turn off “Show on site” above.
account.description: Change your name, email and password.
common.copyFailed: Couldn't copy. Copy the link by hand.
dash.emptyBody: A name, a price and a photo are enough to start. You can fill in the rest later.
dashCat.incomplete: Every category needs a Mongolian name and a code.
dashCat.removeBody: {products} products and {answers} quiz answers use it. Removing it disconnects them, and the quiz stops recommending through those answers. Nothing changes until you save.

prodEd.priceHint: In tögrög, shown exactly like this on the page.

prodEd.quizBody: A quiz that includes this product suggests it when a visitor's answers point to one of the categories below.
prodEd.designBody: Choose how this product's page is laid out and coloured.
prodEd.accentHint: Tints the top of the product page and its photo in the catalog.
prodEd.directLinkBody: Share it on social media, or print it as a QR code on packaging.
prodEd.descShortHint: A sentence or two. The full description goes on the next page.
products.quizBody: Answer a few questions and find out which one fits you.
qr.hint: PNG for screens, SVG for print. Scans are counted separately in Stats.
quizEd.deadAnswer: None of this quiz's products carry this category — this answer won't suggest anything

quizEd.incomplete: Every question and answer needs Mongolian text.
quizEd.removeBody: The question and all its answers are removed. Nothing changes until you save.
